question: In June 2025, government of India has organized a National Consultation on Gender Budgeting in————— .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vigyan Bhawan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vigyan Bhawan** is an iconic conference center located in **New Delhi, India**, used for hosting national and international events, seminars, and consultations.
 
• The **National Consultation on Gender Budgeting** organized by the Government of India in **June 2025** focused on enhancing strategies to incorporate gender perspectives into budgeting processes.
 
• Gender Budgeting is a **methodology** for analyzing government budgets to ensure equitable resource allocation for women and men, addressing **gender inequalities**.
 
• Vigyan Bhawan has historically been the venue for significant governmental discussions, making it a suitable choice for such consultations.
 
• The consultation witnessed participation from **policy experts, economists, and government officials** to assess the impact of gender-sensitive budgeting practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vigyan Bhawan**:

 
 
• Constructed in **1956**, Vigyan Bhawan serves as a premier venue for government-hosted events, including international conventions and discussions.
 
• It is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities such as conference halls, meeting rooms, and a media center, making it ideal for large-scale consultations.
 
 
 
• **Gender Budgeting**:
 
 
• Gender Budgeting was first introduced by the Government of India in the **2005-2006 Union Budget**.
 
• It aims to integrate a **gender perspective** into financial planning and allocation processes to reduce disparities.
 
• Key features include analyzing resource allocation for women-centric programs and addressing systemic issues affecting **women’s empowerment**.
 
 
 
• **Historical Venues for Government Events:**
 
 
• **Andhra Bhawan:** A residential complex primarily used to accommodate officials and dignitaries from Andhra Pradesh.
 
• **Rail Bhawan:** Headquarters of the Ministry of Railways, primarily used for administrative purposes.
 
• **Hyderabad House:** A heritage building in Delhi, often used for hosting **state dinners** and bilateral meetings.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Gender Budgeting:**
 
 
• Gender Budgeting ensures **inclusive growth** by addressing gender-specific challenges in areas such as **health, education, employment, and social welfare**.
 
• India’s efforts in gender budgeting have inspired other nations to adopt similar approaches to improve gender equity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Government of India Initiatives:**

 
 
• Several ministries incorporate **gender budgeting cells** to ensure targeted resource allocation for addressing women’s issues.
 
• Programs like **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao**, **POSHAN Abhiyaan**, and **STEP (Support to Training and Employment Program for Women)** have been strengthened through gender budgeting.
 
 
 
• **Global Perspective:**
 
 
• Countries like **Australia, South Africa, and the UK** have adopted gender budgeting practices to address gender disparities effectively.
 
• The **UNDP (United Nations Development Programme)** supports nations in implementing gender-sensitive approaches in budgeting.
